prompt.alinti: Claude can make a thousand videos for near zero dollars. If you don't have a big budget or a big team, you definitely want to watch this and save it for later. Here's how it works. You tell Claude, "let's /Flick it." And in seconds, it transcribes your video and starts turning it into fully animated scenes, smooth motion and matching sound effects, ready to post.
It runs on Remotion, the open source engine that turns code straight into real video.
You get a full scene plan built around your brand and aspect ratio.
The creator even built in a live studio, so you can review everything before anything gets finalized.
